notes.title: Mystery Kink is LIVE on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hey Gamers!

We're running a Kickstarter for Mystery Kink NOW! The Kickstarter ends October 31st, Halloween Night!

MYSTERY KINK ON KICKSTARTER

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834902/278af52e4bd274f946742d94d82051c5304613f5.png

We've got some great rewards including:


 Get DRAWN IN THE GAME! by Oleg Okunev. Yes, YOU, can be drawn in Mystery Kink with Vanilla and the girls.
 Awesome autographed limited merch signed by the women of Mystery Kink.
 Comic art prints and "sexy" physical art prints.
 Shirts, mugs, hats, and hoodies.
 Physical Trading cards of Vanilla and the women of Mystery Kink (signed / unsigned).
 Tons more great rewards including a great deal on Ktulhu Solutions games (our partner developer).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834902/93e0e5e2c98488aca896c07d858a7bb62780e9e4.png

As we mentioned above, the Kickstarter ends October 31st so hurry over.

**Some rewards may be available as Kickstarter's new "late pledge" reward program after Oct 31st, but supplies are limited.

Hurry over today!!! MYSTERY KINK ON KICKSTARTER

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834902/9e669915abc67fa16ca6e10094624266f064c1b3.png
